hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active": ?true' && exit 0; [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] && exit 0; h=$( (git diff HEAD; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) | shasum | cut -c1-40); [ "$h" = "$(cat .git/ponytail-reviewed 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0; echo "$h" > .git/ponytail-reviewed; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Code changed. Invoke the ponytail:ponytail-review skill on the uncommitted diff, apply every finding that does not change behavior, then run pnpm build."}'
